articles.summary: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa, April 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - West Bancorporation, Inc. (Nasdaq: WTBA; the “Company”), parent company of West Bank, today reported first quarter 2026 net income of $10.6 million, or $0.61 per diluted common share, compared to fourth quarter 2025 net income of $7.4 million, or $0.43 per diluted common share, and first quarter 2025 net income of $7.8 million, or $0.46 per diluted common share. On April 22, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors declared a regular quarter
articles.title: West Bancorporation, Inc. Announces First Quarter 2026 Financial Results And Declares Quarterly Dividend
